money: 18-digit exact integer string; signed balances permitted
quantity: exact decimal strings, at most 8 fractional digits; gold canonical chi, 1 luong = 10 chi; stock share
objectVersions: All referenced/changed accounts, holdings, target events and reviews must be supplied; extra supplied object versions are also checked. Workspace version is always checked for a new command.
replay: Current authorization first, committed semantic replay before version/preview checks; never retry unknown outcome with a new key.
scope: SYNTHETIC_LOCAL_POSTGRES_EXECUTED; explicit manual catalogs and manual-owner prices; no provider feeds
unsupported: Correction of transfer/investment bundles, sales/shorting/corporate actions and ingestion Review branches are rejected; they require separate workflow contracts. Opening is an immutable declaration; no generic payload edit port.
